_note: Curated (loop 39). Source: communitydragon/trundle.bin.json mSpellCalculations, cross-checked vs a live wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trundle fetch (2026-07-10). Slot mapping confirmed via spellNames: Q=TrundleTrollSmashAbility/TrundleTrollSmash (Chomp), W=trundledesecrateAbility/trundledesecrate (Frozen Domain), E=TrundleCircleAbility/TrundleCircle (Pillar of Ice), R=TrundlePainAbility/TrundlePain (Subjugate), P=TrundleDiseaseOverseerAbility/TrundleDiseaseOverseer (King's Tribute).
_noteP: King's Tribute: wiki confirms pure self-heal on nearby enemy death (% of their max HP), no damage dealt to anyone. BIN's only calc (RegenPercent) is a heal ratio. Correctly no damage -- omitted.
_noteQ: Chomp: TotalDamage = BonusDamage (DataValue, -10/10/30/50/70/90/110) + total AD * ADScaling (mStat 2, no mStatFormula = TOTAL AD, values 1.05-1.65). Wiki: 'Bonus Physical Damage: 10/30/50/70/90 (+15/25/35/45/55% AD)' -- matches exactly. Physical, single hit (empowers Trundle's next basic attack once).
_noteW: Frozen Domain: wiki confirms pure self-buff zone (bonus AS/MS/healing while standing in it), no damage. BIN DataValues are MSBonus/ASBonus/HealingBonus/Duration only. Correctly no damage -- omitted.
_noteE: Pillar of Ice: wiki confirms pure CC (knockback + slow zone); wiki even explicitly notes it deals '0 proc true damage' only as a trigger for on-damage item/rune effects. BIN has no damage-related DataValue/calc for this spell. Correctly no damage -- omitted.
_noteRPercent: R WAS SCORING 0.34 DAMAGE INSTEAD OF 34% OF THE TARGET (fixed loop 488, found by the every-slot sweep). The note below described the hit correctly - a %maxHP hit - and the curation did not: TotalPercentHPDamage was wired through calc, which reads a FRACTION as a flat damage number. Subjugate therefore contributed about a third of one point of damage on Trundles defining ability, and had since loop 39. Now on hpPercentCalc with hpBasis Max, which is what the note always said it was. This is the Zac-W class the coverage sweep exists to catch, and it survived because nothing checked that a hit TAGGED PercentMaxHp actually resolves as a percentage - a validator rule added in the same loop now does.
_noteR: Subjugate: TotalPercentHPDamage = PercentHPDamage (DataValue, 0.15-0.45 = 15-45% max HP) + AP * PercentHPDamageAPRatio (0.0002 = 2% per 100 AP, mStat defaults to AP). Wiki: 'Total Magic Damage: 20/25/30% (+2% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health' -- matches. Magic, %maxHP hit (half applied on cast, half over the next 4s per wiki -- modeled as one combined full-value hit, same convention as Garen R's combined term). Tagged PercentMaxHp.
